text:
Priya (AE): FYI HalcyonHealth reached out about a sudden drop in usage and a procurement review. They reported invoices look higher and are asking if model changes caused it.
Asha (CSM): Noted. Monitoring shows a 63% drop in token volume week-over-week and DAU down ~38%. Their admin roster changed 2026-01-22 and new ML lead Samir is running vendor cost benchmarks.
Ben (Customer Ops): I pulled billing: invoice totals show a 20% increase quarter-on-quarter for equivalent token buckets. Uploaded invoices + token-level CSV to INC-9981 -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-9981
Miguel (Solutions Eng): Possible causes: variant flip (gptx-2 -> gptx-2-rc), different quantization, routing to higher-cost region, or a request mix change (more long-context calls). I'll run a replay of traffic and a cost-simulation.
Priya (AE): They insist "no deliberate changes" on their side. Samir asked for a simple two-slide comparison: 1) per-token cost delta, 2) demo of 2-week Dedicated trial showing savings.
Miguel (Solutions Eng): Triage checklist from my side:
- confirm model variant timeline from model-audit logs
- replay last 7 days of requests with original variants
- run Optimize's quantized vs base cost sim
Quick commands I'll run:
```
redwood audit models --account halcyon --since 2026-02-15
redwood replay --account halcyon --days 7 --out /tmp/halcyon-7d.json
redwood optimize compare --replay /tmp/halcyon-7d.json --variants gptx-2,gptx-2-quant
```
Asha (CSM): I'll schedule an enablement call with Samir + procurement for Thur 11am PT. Priya, can you prepare the Dedicated offer draft? Mention credits to offset their baseline 1.2M monthly tokens.
Priya (AE): Yes. I'll draft the commercial slide and an offer for a 2-week Dedicated evaluation with a committed floor and discounted per-token price.
Ben (Customer Ops): CSV and invoices are in INC-9981. Also noticed payment method changed 2026-03-04; may correlate with billing alerting.
triage-bot: Ticket INC-9981 created and assigned to customer-success. SLA: 72h.
Miguel (Solutions Eng): ETA: replay + preliminary Optimize report by EOD today. If replay shows higher tokenization or longer sequences, we'll show a concrete per-1k token delta and a config to reduce it. Example config to enable prefix caching & quantized variant on their route:
```
route: halcyon/api
model: gptx-2-quant
cache:
  prefix_cache: true
  ttl_seconds: 3600
batching:
  max_tokens: 2048
  timeout_ms: 10
```
Asha (CSM): For the customer call, success criteria: projected monthly savings >=15% OR a non-cost blocker fixed (e.g., 502 errors). Please capture P95 before/after for the demo.
Priya (AE): I'll include a one-pager for procurement comparing Hosted vs Dedicated costs and a timeline for the trial.
Ben (Customer Ops): Added a note in the ticket with invoice diffs and the token CSV. :white_check_mark:
Miguel (Solutions Eng): Uploaded replay artifacts and Optimize summary to INC-9981. Early signal: model variant changed on 2026-03-02 and about 28% of calls increased prompt length by >1.5x. I can simulate a quantized route that shows ~18% token-cost reduction in our sim.
Asha (CSM): Great. I'll send the calendar invite and attach the two-slide summary once Priya posts it.
Priya (AE): Drafted slides and offer in INC-9981 under attachments. Please review before I send to Samir.
Asha (CSM): Reviewed and made edits. Sending invite now. :thumbsup:
Priya (AE): Thanks everyone. Goal: have demo + offer ready for Thu call and propose Dedicated trial if numbers look good.
(thumbs: :rocket: Miguel, :eyes: Priya)
